title: Defying Fate and Changing Destiny
next_chapter_hook: The gaze of the Heavenly Eye completely shifted, and the location of the complete Tianji Record appeared for the first time—it lies in the depths of the Heavenly Eye's core, and Chen Ji's father Chen Tianming may still be alive

text.content: Just as the boundary between the third and fourth pages of the Tianji Record began to blur, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power breaking free from its chains—and he had to make a choice in that instant, enduring the ultimate backlash of destiny. That power was like thousands of blades cutting simultaneously into his meridians, every inch of flesh and blood screaming in agony. The backlash from the chains came so violently it seemed to tear his soul apart. But he was prepared—his left hand slammed against his fontanel, pouring all the Heavenly Fate Value into his bloodline, letting the backlash force flood into his limbs like a tide.

dialogue.content: "You're insane!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, "Pouring all Heavenly Fate Value into the bloodline? This is no different from seeking death!"

text.content: A cold smile actually curved Chen Ji's lips. In this extreme pain, he反而 felt an unprecedented clarity—the scenes from Chapter 700's death prophecy unfolded before his eyes like a torn scroll. The threads of fate woven around his neck tightened with the slightest misstep, ready to strangle him. But now, he would personally sever one of those threads.

choice.prompt: The backlash from the chains surged like a tide, the critical moment of bloodline awakening—how will Chen Ji endure this heart-wrenching agony?

choices.text: Using pain to combat pain, forcibly suppressing it
choices.description: Transforming pain into a catalyst for power, using willpower to forcibly suppress the backlash, accelerating the completion of bloodline awakening
choices.risk_hint: Failure will result in immediate death

text.content: Chen Ji bit his teeth to pieces, blood streaming down his mouth corners. He didn't scream; instead, he let out a low roar—squeezing the pain like wringing out a cloth, converting it into power and reversely pouring it into his bloodline.

choices.text: Guide the backlash, find an alternative path
choices.description: Not directly resisting the backlash force, but guiding it toward the Tianji Record, using it as a medium to transform this destructive force
choices.visible_cost: May damage the Tianji Record fragments
choices.visible_reward: Tianji Record fourth layer unlock progress improved
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record may be damaged as a result

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, guiding that destructive force toward the Tianji Record. Every previous guidance had pained him, but this time was different—he was going to make a big gamble.

The moment Chen Ji converted pain into power, something in the depths of his bloodline seemed to awaken. A brilliant golden light bloomed from his chest, like a slumbering giant beast opening its eyes after ten thousand years. Bloodline awakening—eighty percent! His meridians instantly expanded tenfold, and true essence surged out like a breached flood.

Meanwhile, the boundary between the third and fourth pages of the Tianji Record completely disappeared. The originally incomplete pages began to self-repair, dense runes writhing and arranging like living creatures. An ancient and majestic voice rang in his mind: "Tianji Record fourth layer, unlocked." At this moment, Chen Ji felt the pulse of destiny—he could touch it now.

dialogue.content: "This is... Defying Fate and Changing Destiny!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out an exclamation, "The fourth layer of the Tianji Record grants you the power to rewrite fate! Within a short time, you can ignore the laws of heaven and directly篡改既定命运轨迹!"

text.content: Chen Ji felt this brand new power. This wasn't about foreseeing the future, but directly rewriting it! As long as he paid enough price, he could turn the impossible into the possible. The death prophecy from Chapter 700 flickered before his eyes—that destined ending showed its first crack.

choice.prompt: The fourth layer of the Tianji Record is unlocked, the power of defying fate at his fingertips—how will Chen Ji use this power to rewrite destiny?

choices.description: Immediately use the new ability, modifying one small detail of the death ending in Chapter 700 to create a sliver of opportunity for himself
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of True Qi
choices.visible_reward: The first flaw appears in the death prophecy
choices.risk_hint: The commotion may be too large and alarm higher existences

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate, forming seals with both hands. A golden rune shot from his fingertips, directly cutting into the death prophecy of Chapter 700. That originally unbreakable thread of fate was actually nudged by him!

choices.text: First stabilize the foundation, secretly lay out the board
choices.description: Not rushing, first fully digest the new ability, use foresight to find the best opportunity before acting
choices.visible_reward: More proficient use of the ability

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his impulse. At this critical moment, rash action would only expose his trump card. He sat cross-legged, beginning to digest this brand new power while using the Tianji Record to deduce the next move.

The moment Chen Ji rewrote the death prophecy, his perception suddenly expanded to a new dimension. He felt a gaze from the Nine Heavens—that was the Heavenly Eye! Its gaze had been pressing down on him like a mountain, and now that pressure was shifting. As if something more important had appeared.

dialogue.content: A cold voice came from the depths of the void: "Interesting... an ant actually learned to bite heaven." That voice held no anger, but rather a hint of playfulness, "But do you think that's enough?"

text.content: The moment the Heavenly Eye's gaze shifted, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented lightness. But immediately after, a deeper chill welled up in his heart—he realized something. The location of the complete Tianji Record clearly appeared in his mind at this moment. It wasn't in any secret realm, but in the depths of the Heavenly Eye's core! That place is where all heavenly secrets converge.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently: "Your father... Chen Tianming! He wasn't truly dead back then, but trapped in the deepest part of the Heavenly Eye! If you could enter there..."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart suddenly tightened. Father... is still alive? That man who disappeared protecting the Tianji Record had been waiting there all along for his son to rescue him? Chen Ji's eyes slightly reddened, but quickly returned to calm. No matter what, he must become stronger.

choice.prompt: The news that his father might still be alive struck like thunder—how will Chen Ji face this information that changes everything?

choices.text: Immediately ask Mo Xiansheng for details
choices.description: Press Mo Xiansheng for the truth about his father's imprisonment, and how to enter the Heavenly Eye's core
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may be hiding something

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his voice calm yet carrying a slight tremor: "Mo Xiansheng, my father... what exactly happened?" This was the first time he showed such obvious emotional fluctuation before Mo Xiansheng.

choices.text: Forcefully suppress emotions, continue laying out the board
choices.description: Bury this news deep in your heart, analyze the situation with cold calculation, don't let emotions affect judgment
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity for honesty with Mo Xiansheng

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the surging emotions. He knew very well that at this critical moment, any emotional fluctuation could become a fatal flaw. His father's matter could only be placed at the end of the chess game.

Chen Ji slowly stood up, feeling the brand new power within his body. The fourth layer of the Tianji Record was unlocked, the power of defying fate under his control. The death prophecy of Chapter 700 had been pried open at one corner, though still far from completely rewritten, but it had already proven one thing—fate is not unchangeable.

In the Nine Heavens above, the Heavenly Eye's gaze had completely shifted. That gaze originally locked on Chen Ji was now directed toward a farther place—there, it seemed, an even greater variable was brewing. A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips: it thought shifting attention would make it ignore him? Ridiculous. From this moment on, he was no longer a chess piece to be manipulated.

dialogue.content: "Father... wait for me." Chen Ji said softly, his voice calm yet firm, "And you, Heavenly Eye, think I'm a chess piece? One day, I will let this heaven and earth see what it means to have flawless strategy."

text.content: The Tianji Record glowed slightly in his hand, the runes on the fourth page fully revealed. And in the deepest part of that page, a line of faint, flickering text was barely visible—that was the guide to the location of the complete Tianji Record. Chen Ji cast his gaze toward the Nine Heavens, a flash of determination in his eyes. Defying fate and changing destiny, he had taken the first step. And next came the time to truly enter the arena.

At this moment, Chen Ji sensed a familiar aura approaching—Su Qingyao. She seemed to have detected the anomaly here and was rushing over at full speed. Chen Ji frowned slightly,收敛ing the Tianji Record's aura to its extreme. He still needed time to digest all this. Before Su Qingyao arrived, he had to cover up all his flaws. After all, he still had to continue playing the role of that废物杂役弟子 until the final moment.

However, just as Chen Ji was about to收敛 his aura, the line of text in the deepest part of the Tianji Record's fourth page suddenly glowed. A coordinate, a vision, simultaneously flooded his mind—in the deepest part of the Heavenly Eye, in endless chaos, a man's figure was faintly visible. That figure bore a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, gazing this way with complex eyes. Chen Tianming... he was truly alive. And now, his son finally had the possibility to reach him.

Chen Ji's fists slowly tightened. He had done it—the first step of defying fate, he had taken. And the chess game ahead would be more dangerous than ever. Although the Heavenly Eye's gaze had shifted, those eyes could return at any moment. Before that, he had to set up a deep enough chessboard, to net all enemies in one sweep.

In the distance, Su Qingyao's figure had appeared at the edge of vision. Chen Ji took a deep breath,收敛ing all emotions and putting on that mask of cowardice and calm once more. But deep in his eyes, a fire was burning. Father... wait for me. No matter what price, I will rescue that man from the core of the Heavenly Eye. This is my second step in defying fate, and the most important one. The chessboard of destiny has unfolded, and the one who holds the pieces will ultimately be him—Chen Ji.
